description: This file defines the class AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart, which extends ViewDetail, and is responsible for rendering a Gantt chart view for project templates in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for displaying the view, loading resources, and generating HTML/JavaScript for task management pop-ups and project timeline.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart
classes.description: A view class for displaying a Gantt chart for project templates, including resource loading, task pop-ups, and project timeline calculations.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart view, loads resources, and outputs HTML/JavaScript for task management and project timeline.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Calculates the duration between two dates in months and days, returning a formatted string.
